crossRefs.note: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.”
“Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting…
“Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

translations.web: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
translations.bsb: Were you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
translations.kjv: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
translations.asv: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou brought forth before the hills?
